reviews.title: Great Monitor
reviews.comment: This monitor is amazing just wish it had sound I still give it 5/5 simply because quality is amazing.
reviews.author: DM

reviews.title: Good Budget Display
reviews.comment: This monitor is easy to setup and well worth what I paid for it. It has a nice resolution and FPS rate that would be good for any budget gaming or even work setups. I was hesitant when making this purchase as I wasnt sure how well I would like it but comparing it to my laptop screen it is much better and using it is so enjoyable. Well worth the value
reviews.author: Palmer Ackerbloom

reviews.title: I Know NOTHING, yet…
reviews.comment: I bought this as a Christmas gift for my boyfriend, I purchased two of them just to sweeten his surprise. He was running his pc through what was, in my humble opinion, an outdated tv. I knew exactly what to get him if I could afford such a thing and fortunately this came in my budget. He LOVES them. The brightness and resolution is wonderful for what his pc is capable, the colors are cleaner and in his words “vivid” and his gaming experience is amplified; he’s multitasking, gaming on one monitor, running videos or studying in the other, it’s his world, now, I just idle nearby on my console. It took a second to figure out how to connect these properly, there is a particular cord needed to run this in a dual monitor scenario. I’m told it’s not complicated and this monitor should be compatible for any set up. Overall, from my limited experience, interest, and contact, I’d say they’re worth a buy!
reviews.author: M. Campbell
